De Villiers Claims Australia Ball-Tampered Before Sandpaper Scandal

Former South African cricketer AB de Villiers has stated that Australia began ball-tampering two Test matches before the infamous 'Sandpaper scandal'. He specifically mentioned that the team lost a Test match in Durban due to the ball reversing, implying this was an early instance of the illegal practice. The 'Sandpaper scandal' refers to a ball-tampering incident that occurred during a Test match in Cape Town.
